mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is held constant for two consecutive months above 5.25%, market expectations for future rate cuts increase, lowering the cost of capital and driving S&P 500 forward returns positively over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: FOMC holds or signals hold after a restrictive stance
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day moving average of the same period, or FEDFUNDS drops below 5.25 within 10 days of the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in hourly wage growth (indirect proxy via UNRATE falling) signals a weakening labor market, which tends to depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month by > 10% and UNRATE falls by > 0.2 percentage points in the same month
regime_hint: Early stage of labor market softening
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not negative in > 70% of similar labor-market weakening events, or wage growth recovers faster than joblessness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in retail sales ( proxy via HOUST ) exceeding 2% for three consecutive months predicts stronger near-term consumer demand, which elevates earnings expectations and yields positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by > 2% month-over-month for three consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive in > 80% of such demand expansion episodes, or retail sales decelerate in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 5% in a month coincides with elevated S&P 500 volatility and tends to precede a negative 20-day forward return as market participants anticipate supply-side shocks.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by > 5% in a single month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of INDPRO contraction events of similar magnitude, or production recovers smoothly within 2 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized CPIAUCSL inflation rate falls below 2% for two consecutive months, it reduces the Federal Reserve's incentive to tighten policy, lowering real interest rates and supporting a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL annualized < 2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the 30-day rolling average during such inflation periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in unemployment (PAYEMS) above the 4.0% pre-pandemic trend line, without a concurrent drop in wage growth (UNRATE), creates a labor market imbalance that tends to depress equities and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 4.0 and UNRATE does not fall below previous month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not negative in > 75% of such episodes, or wage growth outpaces joblessness.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising consumer confidence ( proxy via a composite of HOUST and RSAFS ) exceeding 110 points signals a resilient demand environment, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: Average of HOUST and RSAFS > 110 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not positive in > 90% of such confidence episodes, or confidence falls in the following week.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in manufacturing activity (RSAFS) by more than 8% in a month, without a concurrent decline in consumer demand proxies (HOUST), suggests supply-side stress that tends to depress equities and yields negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls by > 8% in a month and HOUST does not decline by > 2% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not negative in > 70% of such supply contractions when demand remains stable.
